title: 🏛️ India AI Impact Summit 2026 — Comprehensive Sovereign AI Governance & Language Stack
attentionJustification: Landmark global AI summit in Global South establishing MANAV vision, Frontier commitments, and BHASHINI voice stack.

constituentArticles.title: MANAV Vision for AI at India AI Impact Summit 2026
constituentArticles.text: PM Narendra Modi unveiled MANAV Vision for AI: Moral systems, Accountable governance, National sovereignty, Accessible & inclusive, Valid & legitimate.

constituentArticles.title: NPCI offers 'UPI One World' wallet to foreign visitors at AI Summit
constituentArticles.text: NPCI offered UPI One World wallet for delegates from 40+ countries at India AI Impact Summit (up to ₹25,000 per load, max ₹50,000/month).

constituentArticles.title: NPCI launches FiMI domain-specific language model for payments
constituentArticles.text: NPCI launched FiMI (Finance Model for India) Small Language Model supporting English, Hindi, Telugu, Bengali on UPI Help Assistant.

constituentArticles.title: NPCI and Nvidia tie up for sovereign AI payment infrastructure
constituentArticles.text: NPCI partnered with Nvidia to scale FiMI SLM infrastructure for sovereign payments.

constituentArticles.title: India AI Impact Summit 2026 held in New Delhi: Seven Chakras & 3 Sutras
constituentArticles.text: First-ever Global AI Summit in Global South (Feb 16-20) based on People, Planet, Progress. Stanford AI Index 2025 ranks India top 3 in AI vibrancy.

constituentArticles.title: MeitY launches VoicERA open-source voice AI stack on BHASHINI
constituentArticles.text: Amitabh Nag (CEO BHASHINI) launched VoicERA in collaboration with EkStep, IIIT Bengaluru, AI4Bharat.

constituentArticles.title: India unveils 'New Delhi Frontier AI Commitments' at AI Summit
constituentArticles.text: Ashwini Vaishnaw unveiled voluntary Frontier AI commitments adopted by global and Indian tech leaders.

constituentArticles.title: Bangladesh becomes 89th signatory to endorse New Delhi Declaration on AI Impact
constituentArticles.text: New Delhi AI Declaration endorsed by 89 countries on principle of Sarvajan Hitaya, Sarvajan Sukhaya.

constituentArticles.title: Casebook on AI and Gender Empowerment launched by MeitY, UN Women, MoWCD
constituentArticles.text: 23 real-world AI solutions from Global South showcased at AI Summit.
